notes: GT units are kg/plant (values ~0.281–0.423), while JSON units are g/plant (values ~264–423). Multiplying GT by 1000 gives exact matches for the two matched pairs. Li 2022 meta-analysis selected only three specific biological spray treatments (Biolan/SWE, Kekkila Oy/Si, Garlic extract/PE) from what appears to be a multi-treatment trial, ignoring Trichoderma, Compost extract, and Gliocladium arms. The GT uses Marketable yield as the outcome metric, not Total yield. JSON extraction captured many more treatment arms and both yield metrics, but missed the garlic extract arm entirely and did not capture 2002 data for the Si and SWE treatments. Frequency=5 in GT likely reflects 5 application events across the season.
